dct_title_s: Story County, Iowa, 1965, aerial photomosaic index
dct_description_sm: Title supplied by cataloger based on information from sheet labels. Images are photoreductions of mosaics created from original aerial photographs. Designating symbol CAB. Form of individual image numbering: CAB-1FF-[number], or CAB-3FF-[number]. "Year Flown 1965". Flown by Park Aerial Surveys, Inc. Louisville, K.Y. "Approximate scale, 1:20,000" [refers to individual images from which mosaic was made].
